3.5 Clustering Coefficient
3.6 Why It Works
Minimal Arbitrariness:  stem from , not free fits, reflecting
“everything affects everything else.”
Scalability:  and  adapt from  to , unifying physics.
Empirical Fit:  match data (e.g., Euclid, LIGO), with .
Elegance: A handful of constants weave a fluid cosmos, surpassing CDM’s patchwork.
